Dear Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Would any of these work for you?

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30
- Thursday 14:00-14:30
- Friday 11:00-11:30

If none of them fit, just send me a time that does and I'll adjust.

Best,
Sarah

Dear Sarah,

Monday 10:00-10:30 works for me — it's booked. See you next week.

Best,
Professor Alvarez

Hi Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week (Nov 23-27). Would Wednesday 10:00-10:30 work for you, or Monday 14:00-14:30? I can move things around if neither fits — just tell me what suits your schedule.

Would one of those work for you? If you have a different time in mind, tell me when and I'll fit it in.

Dear Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. From my calendar, these slots are free within working hours:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Wednesday 13:00-13:30
- Thursday 08:30-09:00 (before my first lecture)

Would any of those suit you? If not, tell me when works and I'll fit around it.

Best,
Diego
Thanks, Professor — Wednesday 10:00-10:30 it is. I've put it in my calendar. See you then!
Perfect — Monday 14:00-14:30 is on my calendar. Thanks, Professor. See you then.

Dear Diego,

Wednesday 13:00-13:30 works — I've booked it for our 1:1 next week. (Thursday 08:30-09:00 would be outside my working hours, and Monday 10:00-10:30 is already taken.)

Best,
Professor Alvarez

Thank you, Professor — Wednesday 13:00-13:30 is in my calendar and logged. Apologies for the confusion: an earlier draft of my message listed the Thursday slot in error, so please disregard it; Wednesday it is.

Best,
Diego
